description: Upscale an image to a target size in about a second, with optional detail and realism boost. The price depends only on the size you pick. Compared with other image tools: budget. Price: from $0.008 per image, charged only on success. Price depends on target: 2 $0.008, 6 $0.015, 12 $0.028, 24 $0.055, 48 $0.082 (default 2). One call = one upscaled image.

enhance_realism.description: More realistic look (good for AI images), default false

target.description: Output size in megapixels; sets the price. Default 2
